quantum_diagnostic.state_metric_note: Direct state inspection was not used on the NVIDIA execution target; the decision uses independent Z- and X-basis CUDA-Q sampling runs. For effective-channel diagnostics, Bell fidelity is the empirical identity-Pauli fraction.
quantum_diagnostic.reason: Strong Z- and X-basis correlations are consistent with the expected PHI_PLUS Bell state.

noise_semantics.independence_assumption: Each configured Bernoulli event is sampled independently. Triggered Paulis compose in the documented order; later events never replace earlier ones.
